newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stay firm, helped by cargo.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stay firm, helped by cargo.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were firm on Wednesday amid buying support in the cargo market and traders said bunker levels might rise further later this week.
Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted at $101/$102 per tonne, up $2/$3, while 180-cst was quoted at $105/$106, up as much as $4.
"I don't think I will close any (380-cst) deal at below $101 per tonne," said one supplier. Traders said support in the cargo market would continue to boost bunker levels.
MDO and gas oil were steady around $160 and $170 per tonne respectively.
